messages.subject: Wordcloud error on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hello,

The following shiny app code works fine on my local machine but when I publish it on shinyapps.io I get the following error: Error: no applicable method for 'meta' applied to an object of class "try-error"

The problem is with the renderPlot function. Has anyone else seen this error?
Thank you.

server.R

library(shiny)
library(twitteR)
library(RCurl)
library(tm)
library(wordcloud)

require(shiny)
require(twitteR)
require(RCurl)
require(tm)
require(wordcloud)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  #other processing code here

    tweets_clean <- tm_map(tweets_clean, removeWords, c(input$term))
    
    wordcloud_rep <- repeatable(wordcloud)
    output$plot <- renderPlot({wordcloud_rep(tweets_clean)})

  }

})
